newsitem.title: JAPAN: HINO MOTORS LOWERS 97/98 THAI SALES TARGET.
newsitem.headline: HINO MOTORS LOWERS 97/98 THAI SALES TARGET.

text.p: Japanese truck maker Hino Motors Ltd said on Thursday it had lowered its sales target in Thailand to 5,500 vehicles from 13,000 for the year ending in March 1998 due to the weakness of the Thai economy.
Hino also said it was considering suspending production in Thailand from mid-August until the end of September for the same reason.
Hino said its truck output in Thailand in July fell 51.8 percent from a year earlier to 640 units.
"We set the targets in late May, but the Thai economy started to look shaky in the latter half of June. We thought this could affect sales of vehicles there," a Hino spokesman said.
Japanese car industry officials have said that demand for cars in Thailand has been slow since the end of 1996.
